title: Planar higher-rank trees have rank at most four
summary: We prove that a finite, connected, singly connected, locally convex higher-rank tree whose $1$-skeleton is planar and which is \emph{non-degenerate}, in the sense that every edge of each colour forms a commuting square with every other colour, has rank at most four. Under these hypotheses this establishes the planarity conjecture stated in \cite{Pask}. The obstruction side of the argument uses only the non-planarity of $K_5$; it makes no appeal to the four-colour theorem.
